body: Ordered the S and it landed exactly like the model photos, cropped right above the waistband. Only gripe is the top button is a little stiff to close one-handed.

The medium blue wash is close to the site photos, maybe a shade lighter in daylight. Sleeves run slightly long on me and I'm not petite, so I've been rolling the cuffs. Otherwise a solid jacket for the price and it pairs well with almost everything in my closet.
Denim feels sturdy, not stiff. Sized down to XS for a snug fit through the shoulders and it worked out great.
It's fine. Fits true to size in the M, crop length is shorter than I pictured, sits well above my belly button. Not much else to say.

Bought this for weekend errands and it's been great over hoodies and tank tops both. There was one loose thread near the hem when it arrived, snipped it off and no issue since. The stitching elsewhere looks clean and the pockets are a nice functional touch.

I was ready to be a little disappointed given the price point but this actually feels more expensive than it is. The wash is a nice medium blue, not too light or too dark, and the buttons feel secure. Got the L for an oversized look on purpose and it delivers exactly that.
The cut through the body is roomy but I noticed some pull across the shoulders in my usual size, M. Went with the L instead, better now. Would still buy again.
Hits right at the waist, no fading after washing.

Disappointed with this one honestly. The photos show a light-medium wash but what arrived looks almost like a dark indigo, nothing like the listing. Fit is okay in the M but I mostly bought it for that specific color and it just isn't it. Considering returning.
I already own two other jackets from here and this one keeps the same quality I've come to expect. Consistent sizing too, ordered my usual S and it matched perfectly.

Got this for my sister's birthday since she'd been eyeing something similar. Went with M based on her usual size but it's noticeably roomy on her, swimming a bit in the shoulders and sleeves, probably should have gone S. She still likes it and says the denim feels sturdier than jackets twice the price, so overall a win despite the sizing miss. Packaging was simple but the jacket itself arrived in perfect condition.

For a cropped style I was worried it'd feel like a costume piece but it's genuinely wearable denim. Good weight, moves fine when I'm walking around, doesn't restrict my arms reaching for things on shelves at work. Sized up to M from my usual S for a bit more ease and glad I did.
It is what it is for the price. XS fits close to true to size, denim wrinkles more than I'd like. Not sending it back, just not blown away.

I throw this on over leggings after the gym and it still looks put together instead of like I'm still mid-workout. Has enough give across the back for reaching and stretching, which genuinely surprised me for a denim jacket, most rigid fabrics fight you the second you lift your arms overhead. Grabbed the S, true to size through the shoulders and torso, and it's held up through weekly washes with zero shrinkage so far, still the same length and cut as day one. The pockets are deep enough to actually hold my phone during a walk, which sounds minor but matters more than I expected. Would order the same style in another wash if they add one 🙂
Jacket itself is nice, fits true to size in L, decent weight to the denim. My only complaint is delivery took about four extra days.
